## Model evidence

- [ ] The active engine remains clearly labelled.
- [ ] Model version and cost assumptions remain traceable.
- [ ] Changed model behavior has a deterministic normal case and boundary/failure case.
- [ ] `MODEL_CARD.md` was updated, or this change has no effect on model meaning or evidence.
- [ ] Calibration data were not presented as independent validation data.

## Project checks

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests were added or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] An English HTML work log was added and indexed newest first.
- [ ] No secret, private greenhouse data, thesis content, experiment result, or protected research material is included.
- [ ] External GreenLight-Gym2 source remains read-only.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up work are stated.

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible interface changes, or write "Not applicable."
